summary: Frontend-only re-test of the live on-chain rail on /app. Verified rail is present on LEFT at x=0, width=340px on desktop 1920x800, with cypherpunk-styled black background (rgb(7,8,10)), monospace JetBrains Mono font, terminal-style header with traffic-light dots and prompt 'root@nullcash:~$ watch --chain', '// live tx stream' comment, stats rows (merkle root, commitments 1,076, nullifiers 279, verified tokens 49/72), and 34 tx-stream entries with [TYPE] tags and relative time. All entries are <a> elements linking to solscan.io with target=_blank. Main content remains centered right of rail; top tabs (Home, Shield, ..., Private route) not overlapped; Connect wallet visible. Tablet 1280x800: rail hidden ✓. Mobile 400x800: rail hidden ✓, dock present ✓, no horizontal overflow ✓. Private route quick regression (SOL->USDC 0.5 to 0x68b3a9f8940f418e8051ebb659e8ed278fea41f6) produced live quotes successfully (Route 1 Best 50.197 USDC, ~19 min, rate 100.394).

issues: Spec called for a blinking cursor in the terminal header; no element with cursor/blink animation detected (minor cosmetic). Stats rows and relative timestamps did not change over a 6s observation window — if they are intended to tick live, polling appears to be throttled or disabled (relative times stay the same).

action_items: Optional: add a blinking cursor glyph (▊/_) after the 'watch --chain' header to match the described terminal aesthetic.
Optional: ensure the rail's relative timestamps / stat counters actually refresh client-side so the 'live' feel is observable.
critical_code_review_comments: Rail content on /app is static HTML with pre-rendered relative timestamps ('13 min ago', '2 h ago'); if the goal is a live rail there should be a client-side ticker that re-computes elapsed time and/or polls new events.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rail markup: <aside class="rail"> with .rail-h (terminal header incl. 3 traffic-light dots + 'root@nullcash:~$ watch --chain'), .rail-stats (merkle/commitments/nullifiers/verified tokens), .feed > a.ev (each event). Breakpoints hide rail below ~1440px. /app route gates behind a Welcome modal — click 'Skip intro' to proceed to tabs. Private route tab uses token selectors labeled 'Select'; the amount input has placeholder '0' and the destination address input has placeholder 'Your receiving address'.
